text: {"lessons":["I sold several stocks once they showed gains, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should weigh each holding’s future prospects and portfolio role.","I later bought stocks back, which reinforces that trading around my average cost can be costly; I should make deliberate decisions rather than seek the satisfaction of realizing gains.","My account value fell despite periods with little trading, so I should judge results across the whole portfolio and not assume that inactivity or past price moves predict what comes next."]}
